## Why This Platform?

How popular is this platform? How many jobs do you typically apply to here?

## Application Process

- Do you click an "Apply" button?
- Is there a form submission?
- Does it redirect to another site?

## Technical Details (Optional)

- URL pattern: [e.g., *.greenhouse.io]
- Selectors for company name: [e.g., .company-name]
- Selectors for job title: [e.g., .job-title]
- Application submit trigger: [e.g., form submit, button click]
